pre_flight_question: Is the 13-step GEC verification order normative (MUST follow this order) or advisory? RESOLVED from draft text, §8.1: 'MUST perform the following verification steps in order' and 'All thirteen steps MUST pass before the GEC proceeds to Cedar policy evaluation.' Normative. Sample MUST enforce strict order and short-circuit on first failure.

logs.description: Human principal hp-001 issues a Root Mandate to ota-booking-agent-v2, mandate_ceiling 2, consent_scope present (BOOKING, AI_AGENT_OPERATION), sub_agent_scope RESTRICT.

GEC verifies the Root Mandate from H-01 end to end: aud match, EdDSA alg, valid signature, unexpired, not revoked, so_id/so_type_id match, human_principal_id match, ceiling sufficient, no parent so narrowing skipped, cedar_action in scope, state/phase permitted, no mission_ref present, consent_scope present with matching purpose code.

GEC issues a Child Mandate to weather-monitor-agent-v1 from H-01's Root Mandate: cedar_actions narrowed to [atp:booking:suspend], permitted_states narrowed to [IN_JOURNEY], exp earlier than parent, sub_agent_scope narrowed RESTRICT -> NONE, purpose_codes narrowed to [BOOKING].

logs.scenario: Child Mandate full verification incl. Narrowing
logs.description: GEC verifies H-03's Child Mandate: all 12 prior steps as H-02, plus Step 9 Narrowing Property check across all seven dimensions against the parent, all pass.

Child Mandate's delegation_chain array carries two entries: the Root Mandate issuance (gec_signature: human_issued) and the Child Mandate issuance (gec_signature: Ed25519 signature), per the McGuinness Actor Profile chain format adopted without modification.

Root Mandate has sub_agent_scope INHERIT; Child Mandate is issued with sub_agent_scope INHERIT and an identical consent_scope object — permitted under narrowing rule 'Parent INHERIT => Child MAY be INHERIT, RESTRICT, or NONE'.
Root Mandate has sub_agent_scope RESTRICT; Child Mandate is issued with sub_agent_scope NONE — permitted ('Parent RESTRICT => Child MUST be RESTRICT or NONE').

Kernel reads consent_scope at session start and populates context.data_subject_consent_present=true, context.consent_purpose_codes=[BOOKING, AI_AGENT_OPERATION], context.consent_jurisdiction=JP, context.consent_expiry=2026-08-15T08:00:00Z.
MJWT aud exactly matches the verifying GEC's KIA-attested instance identifier (kernel_keypair_fingerprint).
JOSE header alg is EdDSA; not none or unsigned. Passes before signature verification is attempted.
Ed25519 signature verifies against the issuer's public key retrieved from the GEC's trusted key store.

logs.scenario: Step 4 temporal validity pass — nbf and exp both satisfied
logs.description: Current time is after nbf and before exp.
jti not present in the Revocation Registry, neither directly nor via cascade.
so_id and so_type_id both match the targeted SO Instance.
human_principal_id in MJWT matches the SO Instance Identity Layer's human_principal_id.
mandate_ceiling (2) is >= GEC conformance level (2).
Requested cedar_action atp:booking:suspend is present in the MJWT's cedar_actions array.

logs.scenario: Step 11 state and phase restriction pass
logs.description: SO Instance current_state IN_JOURNEY is in permitted_states; current_phase ACTIVE is in permitted_phases.
MJWT carries mission_ref mission-uuid-azusa-journey-2026-06-15; IDP submitted with the Transition Request carries the identical value.

logs.scenario: Step 13 consent scope validation pass, all four sub-checks
logs.description: consent_scope present (13a); expiry not passed (13b); purpose code BOOKING present for the requested action (13c); Child Mandate sub_agent_scope NONE is not less restrictive than parent's NONE (13d).

logs.scenario: Step 9 live parent re-verification pass [NEW in -04]
logs.description: GEC re-verifies H-01's Root Mandate live at Step 9 (not from a cached copy): parent jti not present in Revocation Registry, and parent's Ed25519 signature currently verifies against hp-001's public key. Only after both pass does the Narrowing Property check (H-04) proceed. Closes the parent-swap window (MJWT-04 Section 11.8).
